push.title: Feishu Webhook Push
push.description: Asynchronously deliver new SMS and allowlisted app notifications through a durable Feishu queue.

push.enableHelp: Applies to newly stored SMS and notification events. Disabling delivery never blocks device ingestion.
push.redactedHelp: Hide SMS bodies, OTP values, notification titles and bodies, and mask sender identifiers.
push.fullHelp: Send sender identifiers, SMS bodies, OTP candidates, notification titles and bodies to Feishu. The third-party platform will receive sensitive data.
